task.name: Recycle_aluminum_cans
task.when: Between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. when aluminum cans have accumulated

step.action: Remove foil, glass, plastic, steel, paper, cardboard, and trash from 🍷 Aluminum_Can_Collection.
Empty liquid from every aluminum can into 🔧 Gray-Water_IBC.
Put the crushed cans in 🍷 Aluminum_Can_Mesh_Bags.
Secure the mesh bags to 📦 Handcart.
Take the cans to Recycle Camp at 5:35 and Esplanade between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

passWhen.criterion: All accumulated aluminum cans are empty, crushed, and accepted by Recycle Camp.
No non-aluminum material was delivered with the cans.

problem.response: Return the secured mesh bags to camp and try again during posted hours.

reasoning.entry: Current 2026 Burning Man guidance sends empty crushed aluminum cans to Recycle Camp rather than trash.
